profile.headline: Junior Developer and Barista
profile.summary:
I am a barista at Starbucks, and I have a plethora of experience in positions of team cooperation. I am currently a student at Arizona State University, and I am majoring in Graphic Information Technology.

I have been a freelance artist for years, and my dream is to work in a position as a storyboard artist, or create a cartoon series some day. Thank you for viewing my profile and considering me as a candidate! 

Portfolio can be found at:
https://kristenleannebaile.wixsite.com/fluffnflight
https://www.behance.net/kristenbailey5
